name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Coming from Plex? The Plex tab is now a three-step guide that brings your Plex movie and TV libraries into Jellyfin. Sign in with Plex, pick the libraries, and the plugin creates matching Jellyfin libraries over the same folders (or reuses ones you already have), with Plex's cover art, backdrops and descriptions. If Plex runs on another computer, drive or container, add a folder rewrite and check again. A match report shows how many titles found their Plex artwork. The new libraries are ordinary Jellyfin libraries, so sharing with friends and downloads keep working.
